summary: Job scheduling on container groups: controller launches dependencies (project and inventory updates), moves the job from pending to waiting when control capacity allows (one unit per job), the dispatcher starts a worker that creates the pod through the Kubernetes API using the container group's service account and pod spec, and the job shows running while the pod may stay pending up to AWX_CONTAINER_GROUP_POD_PENDING_TIMEOUT. A pod denied by a ResourceQuota sends the job back to pending.
questions: How are container group jobs scheduled on OpenShift?
Why does a job go back to pending in a container group?

What does a ResourceQuota do to AAP jobs?
